workExperiences.company: Institute of Field Robotics (FIBO), King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi (KMUTT)
details: Extended Unitree G1 robotics software for humanoid arm and dexterous-hand control using Meta Quest 3 tracking, DDS communication, inverse kinematics, and real-time image/control pipelines.
Developed an Azure Kinect motion pipeline from body tracking and skeleton processing through SMPL pose conversion and ZeroMQ communication for humanoid simulation and control.
Integrated Inspire RH56DFX dexterous hands with Python control, Modbus RTU over USB-RS485, gesture commands, and force/angle telemetry.
Integrated MediaPipe and TensorFlow/TFLite hand-gesture recognition with robotic-hand control, including left/right hand detection and two-hand gesture combinations.

Built a robot-learning data pipeline for Unitree G1 and Inspire dexterous hands, connecting teleoperation demonstrations and robot/camera-state recording to trajectory processing, LeRobot dataset conversion, imitation-learning policy-training workflows, simulation evaluation, and eventual real-robot inference for grasping, pick-and-place, and object manipulation; bottle opening remains a target task.

Built a motion-capture pipeline from a FOHEART suit through MotionVenus UDP V4003, GMR retargeting, and G1ReferenceProcessor to Unitree G1 29-DoF joint/reference trajectories, with MotionRecorder capture/replay and PKL dataset generation for future whole-body policy training; validated in MuJoCo simulation.
